title: Forfeited Self-Pay Visit Package Visits and the Missed First Appointment Fee
content:
Decision table — package-forfeit share in the fee for a missed first appointment of an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The first-appointment package-forfeit share is 150 percent where the patient's Self-Pay Visit Package history shows two or more package visits forfeited for missed appointments in the three months up to the assessment date (an entry counts when fewer than three whole months separate its date from the assessment date), 125 percent where it shows exactly one, and 100 percent where it shows none. The share is read as a percentage of the first-appointment no-show basis and multiplies it.

**Records read.** The forfeited package visit entries in the patient's Self-Pay Visit Package history, by date.

| Package visits forfeited for missed appointments, three months up to the assessment date | Package-forfeit share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 150 percent |
| exactly one | 125 percent |
| none, or no Self-Pay Visit Package history | 100 percent |

**Counting at the edge (hypothetical, assessment on 5 November).** A forfeited visit dated 6 August counts; one dated 5 August does not.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** Two forfeited visits in the period on a basis of USD 62.50: 150 percent of USD 62.50 is USD 93.75.
